programs.title: Road absurdities 3
programs.desc: Skarżysko-Kamienna will welcome Kamil and Krzysiek with pedestrian lanes painted... halfway down.In this Świętokrzyskie city they will also show an original combination of signs privileging... company cars.Then, the Warsaw-Lublin battle of absurdities will take place in front of the audience.Krzysiek will find double signs in the capital, and Kamil will counter with interesting cases from the eastern part of the country, including:a barrier for pedestrians and cyclists at a railway crossing.The presenters will also look at covered information boards in Sochaczew.
